action.intent: Inspect the fortress population, date, and supplies before establishing food, drink, and shelter.
Return to terrain and open designations to begin shelter and resource work.
Designate nearby trees for cutting and let the woodcutter begin supplying construction timber.
Open mining designations to locate the cursor and plan the fortress entrance.
Open designation menu to select and verify the entrance stair designation.
Designate a two-by-two downward stair entrance near the wagon.
Designate matching up/down stairs one level below the entrance.
Excavate an initial room beside the stairwell and let the miners work.
Inspect the excavation and identify the local ground material before placing workshops.
Inspect the level below the ice for a safer permanent fortress site.
Extend the staircase into the subterranean level.
Let miners excavate the staircase to the subterranean level.
Inspect the staircase and excavation one level above.
Excavate a subterranean room beside the lower staircase.
Inspect the excavated level above to verify stair access and find space for workshops.
Inspect the matching stairway one level below to check excavation access.
Let miners finish the stairs and excavate the soil chamber suitable for farming.
Open carpenter workshop placement on the surface while excavation continues below.
Place the carpenter's workshop on clear ground near the wagon.
Select wood for the carpenter's workshop and allow construction and mining to proceed.
Exit the building menu and allow construction and excavation to proceed.
Inspect the carpenter workshop and available tasks.
Open the carpenter's task menu to begin making beds.
Queue seven beds and three barrels, then let carpentry and mining proceed.
Inspect the underground farm location and farm plot placement controls.
Place a 3×3 farm plot on the excavated soil west of the stairs.
Let dwarves construct the designated farm plot and finish carpenter jobs.
Inspect the completed farm plot and choose crops.
Select plump helmets and assign them to every season.
Select Plump helmets using the crop-list control and apply to all seasons.
Confirm plump helmets for all seasons and place a still beside the farm.
Build the still from willow wood and allow queued construction and farming to progress.
Inspect the completed still and available brewing jobs.
Attempt to queue plant brewing and inspect the still's response.
Return from recipe details to the still controls; brewing needs an empty barrel.
Create an underground food stockpile beside the farm and let workshop production proceed.
Inspect the still and add brewing work now that supplies are being hauled underground.
Inspect why brewing remains unavailable.
Return to play and let the carpenter finish beds and barrels needed for brewing.
Inspect the still and check whether brewing can now be queued.
Inspect brewing options and available containers.
Check which ingredient or container is preventing brewing.
Return to the surface to inspect barrel production at the carpenter's workshop.
Inspect the carpenter's remaining bed and barrel jobs.
Keep barrels in production and begin placing completed beds underground.
Move the bed placement cursor onto excavated floor and select a bed.
Place the selected bed and let dwarves install it and finish barrels.
Inspect the installed bed and configure communal sleeping space.
Define a shared sleeping room from the completed bed.
Expand the bedroom footprint and confirm it so it can become a shared dormitory.
Enable the shared dormitory and place another bed beside its first bed.
Install five more beds along the dormitory wall and allow construction and barrel production to proceed.
Inspect the still and add brewing now that barrels have had time to finish.
Open the still's task menu to start brewing drinks.
Start repeating plant brewing and allow production to proceed.
Inspect the apparent flooding before advancing time.
Inspect the surface above the flooded underground rooms to choose a safe relocation site.
Place a replacement still on dry ground near the wagon.
Select a nearby willow log and allow construction of the surface still.
Leave the build menu and let dwarves construct the surface still.
Inspect the new still and its available brewing jobs.
Open the still's job menu to start brewing drinks.
Queue plant brewing and enable repeat to establish a drink supply.
Close the brewing recipe details and inspect the still menu.
Open plant-gathering designations to supply food and brewing ingredients.
Designate a broad patch of nearby plants for gathering and let dwarves harvest.
Inspect the nearby workshop and its available jobs after gathering plants.
Open the still's job menu to start brewing.
